scope: Local guide-program read authorization, query-failure handling and active-member lookup. Four GET routes and two helpers; existing writes, browser identity lifecycle and hosted state unchanged.
scenarioNames: Anonymous detail, sessions and personal-program reads stop before creating a data client
Invalid and general identifiers do not reach program data even for a signed-in member
A current member receives only the existing bounded detail projection and ordered dates
The assigned guide can read without a roster row; a generic guide flag grants nothing
Membership in another program and caller-supplied member IDs cannot reveal this program
Removing membership or changing the assigned guide revokes the next read
Missing programs return not found without reading rosters or sessions
Authorization query failures deny reads as unavailable without fetching private content
Authorized detail lookup failures never become a successful empty or partial detail
The sessions endpoint returns a bounded projection, a real empty list, or an explicit failure
Statistics reject each failed source query instead of inventing zero counts
Public listings retain their exact bounded projection and verified member count
Failed or missing public counts are unavailable, never zero members presented as known
Listing failure differs from a genuinely empty list
Personal-program lookup stays bound to the current member and preserves its DTO
Personal-program statistics and guide failures become generic private errors
A completed membership cannot hide an active program in either member lookup
Unexpected identity or data-client failures do not leak exception details
The program authorization helper never adopts the shared chat general-room exception
dataTestScope: Actual source and locked Supabase SDK over disposable PGlite PostgreSQL data based on the historical guide schema; bounded transport adapter and synthetic verified identity, not hosted PostgREST/Auth/RLS.
httpScope: Ten actual compiled loopback GET requests, no API interception. Only nonissued hints/tokens and signed-out state; no real authenticated/provider/hosted/device acceptance. No writes or issued credentials.

retainedCorrections.reason: Disposable PostgreSQL DATE values decoded as JS Date objects. The bounded transport now emits SQL DATE text matching PostgREST; the application was not changed to accept a synthetic timestamp.

The HTTP checker initially inspected only the first Vary header. It now combines repeated header fields and requires Cookie plus Authorization tokens; the observed headers are retained. No application header requirement was weakened.

remaining: Browser account switching/retirement and wallet-only guide-program entry.
Fresh guide-role authority lookup consistent with safe writers.
Atomic/idempotent program creation, joining, attendance and graduation.
Public projection consent and direct hosted data access.
Real recovery, provider/member/device acceptance and confirmed pilot host/schedule.
